test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

He said to the boy, “What are you writing here?”

options.text: He asked the boy what is he writing here?
He asked the boy what he was writing there
He said the boy what are you writing there?
He said to the boy what he is writing here?

solution:
The correct answer is: **He asked the boy what he was writing there**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The given sentence is in direct speech and we need to convert it to an indirect speech.
 
• When we change a direct speech to an indirect speech, we must follow these rules:
 
 
• The reporting verb "said" changes to "**asked**" in the indirect speech when there is an interrogative sentence.
 
• The inverted commas ("...") are removed to show the indirect speech part.
 
• The comma (,) is removed in the indirect speech.
 
• The **question mark (?)** is the direct speech changes to a **full stop (.)** in the indirect speech.
 
• The first word of the indirect speech should be in capital letters.
 
• The present verb form in the direct speech changes to the past tense in the indirect speech. So, "**are**" changes to "**was**."
 
• The second-person pronoun "**you**" changes to the third-person pronoun "**he**" in the indirect speech.
 
 
 
• Thus, according to the rules option 2 is the correct answer.

 

Hence, indirect speech is - *He asked the boy what he was writing there*
